intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Orlando for 2026, and here is what he found: 57 family events, 24 of them free. The magic runs from November 6 (SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration) through January 8, 2027 (Luminary Green Park Holiday Projection Show), with the 2026 Tree Lighting Celebration (December 4), the Holiday Train at Lake Eola Park (December 4 to 20) and Holidays in Heritage Square (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Orlando

  • 57 Christmas events for kids in Orlando
  • 24 free events, including the Holiday Train at Lake Eola Park, the Holiday Stroll, Holiday Movies at Lake Eola Park, Holidays in Heritage Square, the Frontyard Holiday Festival at Dr. Phillips Center and Grinch's Lair
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the Eola House (December 5 to 22), Storytime with Santa and Mrs. Claus, Navidades en Gateway (December 12) and Sleigh the Ford (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the 2026 Tree Lighting Celebration (December 4), Tree Lighting at Albert Park (November 28) and The Packing District Tree Lighting and Holiday Pops (December 4)
  • Trains: the Holiday Train at Lake Eola Park (December 4 to 20) is free, and the free Central Florida Railroad Museum is in nearby Winter Garden
  • Shows and lights: Orlando Ballet's The Nutcracker (December 12 to 27), Dinos in Lights at Orlando Science Center and Disney Springs Christmas Tree Stroll
  • Season: November 6 to January 8, 2027
